params.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} '''Milio's''' {{tip|ability}} hits on himself and allied {{tip|champions}} grant an enchantment for 4 seconds, which causes the next {{tip|basic attack}}<!--not on-hit--> or ability hit against enemies to deal {{as|{{pp|7;11;15|1;6;9|key=%}} of enchanted target's AD}} {{ccs|{{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}}|magic}} and apply a burn that deals{{ft|{{as|{{pplevel|10 to 50}}|magic damage}} {{as|(+ 20% of '''Milio's''' AP)}} {{as|magic damage}}|{{as|{{pplevel|10/6 to 50/6|round=2}}|magic damage}} {{as|(+ {{ap|20/6|round=2}}% of '''Milio's''' AP)}} {{as|magic damage}} every {{fd|0.25}} seconds}}over {{fd|1.5}} seconds.
params.notes:
* Subsequent applications of ''Fired Up!'' only refresh the duration.
* {{tip|Spell shield}} will not block ''Fired Up!'' if applied by a basic attack.
params.damageextra:
* Both the burst and the burn respect {{tip|enchantment redirection}}.
* The damage does not apply if a triggering attack is {{tip|dodge|dodged}}, {{tip|block|blocked}}, or {{tip|blind|misses}}, for all cases.

params.blurb: {{sbc|Innate:}} {{cis|Milio}} abilities enchant allied {{tip|champions}} on-contact, causing their next basic attack or ability hit shortly after to apply a {{ccs|burst|magic}} and then a short burn to the target enemy, both parts dealing {{as|magic damage}}.

params.description: {{sbc|Active:}} After a {{fd|0.25}}-second delay, '''Milio''' kicks a fireball in the target direction that grants {{tip|sight}} of its path and {{tip|airborne|knocks back}} and {{tip|stun|stuns}} the first enemy it hits over 1 second.
params.description2: Upon collision, the ball bounces once in the {{tt|same|parallel to original cast direction}} direction from the target's location, granting sight of the area before exploding in the same radius after a brief delay, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to enemies hit and {{tip|slow|slowing}} them for {{fd|1.5}} seconds.
params.leveling2:
{{st|Magic Damage|{{ap|80 to 320}} {{as|(+ 120% AP)}}}}
{{st|Slow|{{ap|40 to 60}}% {{as|(+ 5% per 100 AP)}}}}
params.description3: If the primary target is a non-champion, the ball knocks back further and creates a larger explosion. ''Ultra Mega Fire Kick'' refunds 50% of its {{sti|{{as|mana cost}}}} if it hits at least one champion with the fireball or explosion.
params.description4: '''''Milio''' cannot cast other abilities during Ultra Mega Fire Kick's delay.''
params.effect radius: {{dv|{{tip|sight|icononly=true}}{{tt|100|Sight radius of missile}}|{{tip|cr|icononly=true}} {{tt|250|Champion hit reveal and explosion radius}}|{{tt|275|Minion hit reveal and explosion radius}}|{{tt|190|Champion knock back distance}}}}

params.blurb: {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Milio}} kicks a fireball in the target direction that briefly {{tip|airborne|knocks back}} and {{tip|stun|stuns}} the first enemy hit. The ball then bounces once toward the target and explodes, dealing {{as|magic damage}} and {{tip|slow|slowing}} enemies hit.
params.blurb2: If the primary target is a non-{{tip|champion}}, the ball knocks back further and creates a larger explosion.

params.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Milio''' summons a fuemigo at the target location or upon the target allied champion for 6 seconds that follows the nearest allied champion and grants {{tip|sight}} of its surroundings. Allied champions near the fuemigo gain {{sti|'''bonus''' attack range}} equal to a percentage of their '''base''' attack range and {{tip|heal}} every {{rutngt|0.25}} over the duration.
params.leveling:
{{st|Base Attack Range Scaling|{{ap|10 to 20}}%}}
{{st|Heal per Tick|{{ap|70/25 to 150/25}} {{as|(+ {{ap|15/25}}% AP)}}|Total Heal|{{ap|70 to 150}} {{as|(+ 15% AP)}}}}
params.description2: ''Cozy Campfire'' can be recast after {{fd|0.5}} seconds within the duration.
params.description3: {{sbc|Recast:}} '''Milio''' commands the fuemigo to follow the target allied champion to within {{tip|cr|icononly=true}} 150-units, placing the recast on a {{sti|cd|{{fd|0.5}}}}-second {{tt|static|Unaffected by ability haste}} cooldown.
params.description4: '''''Milio''' counts as an allied champion for this ability. Cozy Campfire may grant {{ai|Fired Up!|Milio}} upon being summoned and at most once every 3 seconds thereafter.''
params.outofrange: Target at maximum range (first cast clamped regardless of targeting location or ally)
params.notes:
* ''Cozy Campfire's'' initial cast and recast have a {{tip|forgiveness radius}} of 175 units for their unit-targeted version.
** The summoned fuemigo will still follow the nearest allied champion in range, even if the initial cast was targeted on a different ally.
* The {{sti|attack range}} increase lingers on allies for the entire duration of ''Cozy Campfire'', even if they leave the zone.
<!--Blurb-->
params.blurb: {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Milio}} summons a fuemigo that lasts for 6 seconds and follows the closest allied {{tip|champion}}. Allied champions near the fuemigo gain increased {{sti|attack range}} and are continually {{tip|heal|healed}}.
params.blurb2: {{sbc|Recast:}} The fuemigo follows the target allied champion.

params.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Milio''' envelops himself or the target allied champion in protective flames, granting the target a {{tip|shield}} and {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}}}} for {{fd|2.5}} seconds.
params.leveling:
{{st|Shield Strength|{{ap|45 to 165}} {{as|(+ 45% AP)}}}}
{{st|Bonus Movement Speed|{{ap|12 to 20}}%}}
params.description2: '''Milio''' periodically [[stock]]s a ''Warm Hugs'' charge, up to a maximum of 2.
params.description3: ''Warm Hugs' effects can stack up to 2 times.''
params.notes:
* ''Warm Hugs'' has a {{tip|forgiveness radius}} of 175 units.
<!--Blurb-->
params.blurb: {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Milio}} envelops himself or the target ally in protective flames, granting them a {{tip|shield}} and {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' move speed}}}} for a short time.
params.blurb2: '''Milio''' periodically [[stock]]s a ''Warm Hugs'' charge, up to a maximum of 2. The effects can stack up to 2 times.

params.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Milio''' explodes in soothing flames, {{tip|heal|healing}} and {{tip|cleanse|cleansing}} himself and nearby allied champions of non-{{tip|airborne}} {{tip|crowd control}}, and granting them 65% {{tip|tenacity}} for 3 seconds.
params.description2: '''''Milio''' cannot cast his other abilities for {{fd|0.75}} seconds after Breath of Life's activation. Breath of Life cannot be used while affected by {{tip|cast-inhibiting crowd control}}.''
params.blurb: {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Milio}} explodes in soothing flames, {{tip|heal|healing}} and {{tip|cleanse|cleansing}} himself and nearby allied {{tip|champion|champions}} of non-{{tip|airborne}} {{tip|crowd control}} and granting them {{tip|tenacity}} for a short time.
